content:
**The home opens with the work in flight, under a one-line header (#1284)**

brain:ui Map & tracks now opens with an In flight section: one row per OPEN issue joined across changes (main), localWorktrees, remoteChanges and prs (lib/inflight-model.mjs, pure, nowMs injected). Activity = latest of worktree touchedAt, branch tipAt, change-dir lastCommit (one batched git log in readChanges, D94); worktree head commit time (D103, readLocalWorktrees) only as fallback. >=7 days (STALE_DAYS) -> collapsed counted stale group; no time -> activity unknown, never stale. null hierarchy state -> state unknown; unlisted issue -> no row (D96); while hierarchy is not ready only the candidate count and missing sources show (ruled). Kind only when declared (levelSource != default); progress only from a change dir on the served tree. Header is one nowrap line; EPIC_JOIN_PENDING moved to title + an epic band in #banners. Cards with no work in read sections drop the absence line (quietAbsence); the drawer keeps it. Measured 2026-10-04: 54 of 57 non-archived change dirs on main belong to closed issues; 13 of 17 remote-branch issues closed; D94 git log 53 KB / 0.07 s. Publish canary raised to 9.7 MB.
